workflows.title: Intake and Triage
workflows.description: Capture the request, scope, urgency, handling constraints, initial evidence, and triage decision.
body: | In scope | Out of scope | Deadline | Priority |
- [ ] Sensitive or personal data requirements recorded.

workflows.title: IOC and Observable Triage
workflows.description: Normalize an indicator or observable, record provenance, assess validity, and decide its operational disposition.
body: | Is it benign, suspicious, or malicious? |  |  |

workflows.title: Pivot and Enrichment Log
workflows.description: Record each local or external pivot, its inputs, returned facts, provenance, limitations, and resulting leads.
body: | Time (UTC) | Input | Source or tool | Query or method | Result | Confidence |
| Result | Provider or source | Retrieved (UTC) | License or handling | Limitation |
| Lead | Why it matters | Owner | Status |
Record dead ends, duplicate results, rate limits, and reasons a result was not retained.
Separate retrieved facts from inference and state what changed in the investigation.

workflows.title: Analytic Timeline
workflows.description: Order observed events, reported events, and analytic milestones while preserving source time, confidence, and uncertainty.
body: | Time (UTC) | Time type | Event | Objects | Source | Confidence |
Record approximate times, conflicting timestamps, clock skew, collection delay, and unresolved sequence questions.
| Time (UTC) | Decision or judgment | New evidence | Analyst |
Explain the most important ordering, duration, gaps, and causal claims without presenting inference as observation.

workflows.title: Hypothesis Matrix
workflows.description: Compare competing explanations against diagnostic evidence, assumptions, confidence, and collection needs.
body: State one answerable question and the decision it supports.
| ID | Hypothesis | Prior plausibility | Key assumptions |
| Evidence | Source quality | H1 | H2 | Diagnostic value |
- [ ] Considered missing evidence and collection bias.
- [ ] Sought evidence that could disconfirm the leading hypothesis.
- [ ] Recorded analyst assumptions and cognitive-bias risks.
| Question or evidence | Hypothesis distinguished | Priority | Owner |

workflows.title: Peer Review
workflows.description: Review sourcing, logic, alternatives, confidence, markings, STIX references, and readiness for release.
body: - [ ] Source reliability, access, timeliness, and corroboration are assessed.
- [ ] Facts, source claims, and analytic inference are distinguishable.
- [ ] Contradictory evidence and important gaps are visible.
- [ ] Assumptions and inferential steps are explicit.
- [ ] Confidence language matches the evidence and uncertainty.
- [ ] Object types, properties, references, and relationship direction are correct.
- [ ] Markings and granular markings cover sensitive content.
- [ ] Licensing and dissemination constraints are satisfied.
| Severity | Finding | Required change | Owner | Status |
**Decision:** Approve / Approve with corrections / Return for revision
